_meta.description: Parameter distributions for the probability-weighted EV model. All are [M] model assumptions unless tagged; each has a 'basis' tying it to observed benchmarks in research/sources.csv. Distributions are triangular (lo, mode, hi) unless noted.
_meta.exit_multiple_basis: [M] Private B2B SaaS ARR multiples 2025-26 cluster ~3-7x for 20-40% growers; discounted for scale risk. Median Rule of 40 = 28 (S040).
_meta.opex_base_basis: [M] Seed team 6-10 FTE at loaded ~$150-200k; scaled up 35%/yr to Y5

C001_payee_assurance.label: #1 Payee assurance + Nacha controls (lower mid-market)
C001_payee_assurance.reachable_basis: [D] 607k firms 20-499 emp (S057) x [M] 20-45% originating ACH/wire outside AP suites (S082: only 20% fully automated AP)
C001_payee_assurance.penetration_basis: [M] Eftsure+SisID+Relish reached ~4,000 customers over ~10 yrs across 3 regions (S014); 0.7% of reachable = ~1,400 accounts by Y5
C001_payee_assurance.arpa_basis: [E] Below enterprise quote-based tiers (S015,S065); anchored to insurance sublimits $100-250k (S049) and avg BEC complaint ~$123k (S001 [D])
C001_payee_assurance.gm_basis: [M] SaaS 75-85% less per-verification API COGS ($0.10-0.60/call, S086)
C001_payee_assurance.churn_basis: [E] Mid-market annual contracts; SMB monthly 3-7% (S041) is upper bound; compliance evidence raises switching cost
C001_payee_assurance.regime_basis: [F] Nacha rule in force since Jun 2026 (S004); BEC losses rising (S001). Break = rule rescinded or free bank CoP
C001_payee_assurance.compression_basis: [I] AP suites (S062,S064) and banks (S063) bundle verification; Eftsure moving down-market (S014)

C002_bank_channel.label: #2 White-label originator portal sold to community banks/CUs
C002_bank_channel.reachable_basis: [E] ~4k banks + ~4.5k CUs (FDIC/NCUA approx, not re-verified: egress-blocked)
C002_bank_channel.penetration_basis: [M] Bank vendor adoption slow; 9-18 month cycles
C002_bank_channel.cac_basis: [M] Enterprise-like bank sales + vendor due diligence (TPRM)
C002_bank_channel.compression_basis: [I] Core providers (Jack Henry/Fiserv) bundle; fraud vendors (Sardine, Abrigo) adjacent (S079)

C012_idr_automation.label: #12 NSA IDR automation for independent provider groups
C012_idr_automation.reachable_basis: [E] Independent ED/anesthesia/radiology/neonatology groups + RCM firms; 3 orgs ~75% of disputes (S071)
C012_idr_automation.arpa_basis: [E] Contingency share of recovered underpayments; fee cut to $15 increases volume (S068)
C012_idr_automation.gm_basis: [M] Human review of eligibility/offers; IDR entity fees borne by client
C012_idr_automation.regime_basis: [F] Payer RICO suits (S070); payment-methodology rulemaking pending (S068); Congressional risk [I]

C026_drawback.label: #26 SMB duty drawback automation

C026_drawback.regime_basis: [F] Tariff regime litigated/volatile (S027,S054); 232 duties mostly ineligible (S034)

C048_cra_reporting.label: #48 EU CRA vulnerability-reporting workflow for SMB makers
